title: Annotatio III §.VIII open: Fruits of Lipsiacum & Cassellanum not small — reach into the present century
pass_a_gloss: §. VIII. Of either named Effort, the Leipzig and the Cassel, the fruit was not small, which extends itself not only to its own [age] in which they were undertaken and finished a few years ago, but even to the modern Century not so long begun.
pass_b_english: §. VIII. The fruit of both those Consociation attempts — Leipzig and Cassel — was not small.
It reaches not only the age in which they were begun and finished a few years back, but even our present century, itself not long under way.
source_text:
§. VIII.
Utriusque, dicti Moliminis, Lipsiaci & Cassellani fructus haud exiguus fuit, qui se non ad suum tantùm, in quo suscepta sunt, paucisque abhinc annis finitum, sed modernum etiam non ita diu coeptum Seculum extendit.
notes: §.VIII open; fruits thesis; natural stop after seculum extendit.
